title: S1 option A (recommended): the launch step, the scale as one track
can: Pick the project folder, a new worktree or this checkout, the model and effort, and how careful the session is on one 4-step scale (Supervised, Auto-accept edits, Auto, Full access). One line explains the chosen step; every write is recorded on all four. Type the first message to start.

title: S1 option B: the launch step, the scale as four rows
can: The same choices; each step of the scale is a row with its one-line meaning visible at once. Clearer on first use, taller, and two hints per row break R-calm-2's budget, hence A.

title: S2 a running turn in Supervised mode
can: The change waits inline on its tool row: hold to allow once, always allow it this session, or decline. Typing in the composer declines with your reason (the placeholder says so). Feedforward marks what boopis will act on as you type. The status is the answering model's logo, still while it waits.

title: S3 steer or queue while it runs
can: Enter steers the running turn (shown inline as Steer); ctrl Enter queues instead (the setting can flip the default). Queued messages wait above the composer in the engine's own queue: send one now, edit it, or cancel it; they run in order when the turn ends.

title: S4 the finished turn
can: The work log is one collapsed line (Worked for 59s: changed 2 files, ran 1 command); the changed-files card opens the diff; the checkpoint offers Undo, Edit from here and Fork (a journaled ship, so undoable, and never gated). A blank that lapsed stays as an AskCard below, its guess the default answer.

title: S5 the right panel, one panel with tabs: Diff
can: Diff, Files, Terminal and PR are tabs of one panel, opened on request. Diff scopes: this turn, the session, uncommitted, the branch against its base; stacked or split. A comment on a line becomes a chip in the composer (dock.css:42) so the next message carries it.

title: S6 the commit dialog
can: Choose the files (checks, no square boxes), read or edit the message written from the changes, then one stacked action: commit, commit and push, commit, push and open a PR, or commit on a new branch. No agent credits are ever added.

title: S7 option A (recommended): the session list as an inbox, sections in the list
can: Sessions sort themselves: Needs you, Working, Pinned, Recent, then Settled (folded). Hover a row to snooze it (an hour, this evening, tomorrow, when usage resets) or settle it; settled sessions come back when they need you.

title: S7 option B: the inbox as filter chips over one list
can: The same states as filter chips with counts over a flat, sorted list. Denser and one tap to filter, but the needs-you item is not pinned to the top of the eye, hence A.

title: S8 a mid-session settings change
can: Anything can change mid-session. The model switches in place; a change to permissions, workspace or tools continues the same thread on a new engine session, shown as one line with the cache-miss cost.

title: S9 a blank waiting in the reply
can: The agent pauses on a question inside its reply: answer in the gap before the countdown ends and it goes on from your answer in the same reply; otherwise it lapses, goes on with its guess, and leaves the AskCard (S4).
